sections.title: Dilution
sections.excerpt:
DILUTION The
sale of ordinary shares to the Selling Shareholders pursuant to the Purchase Agreement will have a dilutive impact on our shareholders.
In addition, the lower the price of the ordinary shares is at the time we exercise our right to issue and sell ordinary shares to Selling
Shareholders, the more of the ordinary shares we will issue to raise our desired amount of proceeds from the sale, and the greater the
dilution to our existing shareholders. The
price that the Selling Shareholders will receive for the ordinary shares when resold pursuant to this prospectus will depend upon the
timing of sales and will fluctuate based on the trading price of the ordinary shares. We
calculate net tangible book value per ordinary share by dividing our net tangible book value, which is tangible assets less total liabilities,
